items.t: eHealth: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.sum: Carrier sponsorship payments are returning this enrollment season, a shift that bears directly on how eHealth's distribution revenue rebuilds into 2027.

items.t: eHealth Sees Medicare Balancing Act: AI for Answers, Agents for Advice
items.sum: EHTH finds 75% of Medicare shoppers used AI to review 2027 plans, yet 50% relied most on agents as rising costs and coverage shifts complicate choices.
